Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style

Class SldExpression

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.SldExpression
public abstract class SldExpression extends Object
An OGC expression that can appear as a value within SLD 1.0 symbolizer properties or OGC Filter comparison operands.

Mirrors the GeoTools Expression hierarchy — specifically PropertyName, Literal, Function, and arithmetic nodes — without requiring any GeoTools dependency. Instances are created via the static factory methods on this class and are immutable.

Where expressions are accepted

  • Symbolizer numeric properties: size, rotation, opacity (e.g. in SldBuilder.PointBuilder.size(SldExpression), SldBuilder.PointBuilder.rotation(SldExpression))
  • Text label content: SldBuilder.RuleBuilder.label(SldExpression)
  • Filter comparison operands: OgcFilters.equalTo(SldExpression, SldExpression) and its sibling methods

Usage


 import static io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.SldExpression.*;
 import static io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.OgcFilters.*;

 // Proportional symbol — symbol size driven by a feature attribute
 rule.mark(WellKnownName.CIRCLE)
     .fill("#FF0000")
     .size(property("magnitude"))
     .end();

 // Rotation driven by a feature attribute
 rule.mark(WellKnownName.TRIANGLE)
     .fill("#0000FF").size(12)
     .rotation(property("bearing"))
     .end();

 // Dynamic label from two concatenated attributes
 rule.label(function("strConcat",
         property("name"),
         literal(" ("),
         property("type"),
         literal(")")));

 // OGC function in a filter comparison
 OgcFilter f = equalTo(
     function("strToLowerCase", property("road_type")),
     literal("highway"));

 // Arithmetic: label showing population in thousands
 rule.label(function("numberFormat",
         literal("0.0"),
         div(property("population"), literal(1000))));

  • Method Details

    • property

      public static SldExpression property(String name)
      Creates a <ogc:PropertyName> expression that references a feature attribute by name.

      At render/evaluation time, the value of the named attribute is substituted. Equivalent to GeoTools FilterFactory.property(String).

      Generates: <ogc:PropertyName>name</ogc:PropertyName>

      Parameters:
      name - the attribute (property) name as it appears in the feature type; must not be null
      Returns:
      a SldExpression representing the property reference

    • literal

      public static SldExpression literal(Object value)
      Creates an <ogc:Literal> expression for a constant value.

      The value is converted to a string via Object.toString() and XML-escaped. Equivalent to GeoTools FilterFactory.literal(Object).

      Generates: <ogc:Literal>value</ogc:Literal>

      Parameters:
      value - the literal value; Number and String are the most common types; toString() is called for all other types
      Returns:
      a SldExpression representing the constant literal

    • function

      public static SldExpression function(String name, SldExpression... args)
      Creates an <ogc:Function> expression that invokes a named OGC function.

      GeoServer ships many built-in OGC functions. Commonly used ones include:

      • strToLowerCase(expr) — converts a string to lower case
      • strConcat(expr, expr, …) — concatenates multiple expressions as strings
      • numberFormat(pattern, number) — formats a number using a Java DecimalFormat pattern
      • categorize(value, v1, t1, v2, t2, …) — piecewise constant function
      • interpolate(value, d1, v1, d2, v2, …) — linear interpolation
      • recode(value, k1, v1, k2, v2, …) — explicit value mapping (lookup table)

      Generates: <ogc:Function name="name">arg1 arg2 …</ogc:Function>

      Parameters:
      name - the OGC function name as registered in GeoServer; must not be null
      args - the function argument expressions; may be empty for zero-argument functions
      Returns:
      a SldExpression representing the function invocation
